units.source_text: 一大捆一大捆的草，把背着它的妇女们的身子全给遮住了。

en.t: Large bundles of grass completely hid the bodies of the women carrying them on their backs.

units.source_text: 走过去时，草捆划着坡道的石崖，沙沙作响。

en.t: As they passed, the grass bundles scraped against the stone cliffs of the sloping road with a rustling sound.
The ears of grass were very sturdy.
